_note: Register fragment for woo-decision-shows-what-was-withheld (REQ-WDW-001). One withheldDocument per document of a Woo decision that was not made public, recorded by dossiq through WithheldDocuments::record(). It holds the position on the inventory and the refusal grounds as dossiq's list named them, and nothing of the document: no title, file, hash, reference or text. Admin-only, as wooAssessment: the public read (REQ-WDW-003) answers through the publication, never through the object API.

withheldDocument.comment: One withheld document of a Woo decision: its position and the grounds, never its content

withheldDocument.title: Withheld document
withheldDocument.summary: A document of a Woo decision that was not made public, and why
withheldDocument.description: Records that the document at this position on the decision's inventory was withheld, and on which refusal grounds. It never holds the document itself: no title, no file, no hash, no reference and no text, so the record of what was withheld cannot leak what was withheld.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication of the Woo decision this document belongs to.

position.title: Position
position.description: The document's number on the decision's inventory.

grounds.title: Grounds
grounds.description: The grounds it was withheld on. Each holds the code, article and label from dossiq's list.

article.title: Article
article.description: The article of the Woo the ground rests on.

label.title: Label
label.description: The ground in words, as dossiq's list names it.

source.title: Source
source.description: The app that recorded the entry, such as dossiq.
